title: The Combinatorics of Affine Deodhar Diagrams
summary: Deodhar diagrams give a combinatorial way to compute point counts of open positroid varieties over finite fields. We introduce affine Deodhar diagrams, which extend this construction to affine patches of open positroid varieties. These diagrams are indexed by a bounded affine permutation together with a lattice path, and this extra flexibility makes them especially useful for recursive bijections.
